spells.name: Acupuncture
spells.description: Around a targeted creature, create a field of blood needles in every direction, shooting down and healing you for 25% of damage done

spells.name: Blood Needles
spells.description: Create a ring of needles made from blood and fire them forward, skewering targets and healing you for 25% of damage done

spells.name: Blood Slash
spells.description: Slash forward to send out a concentrated blade of blood, slicing through creatures and healing for 15% of damage done.

spells.name: Blood Step
spells.description: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, or directly behind any targeted creature. Gain a short duration of true invisibility upon reaching your destination.

spells.name: Devour
spells.description: Pull in a nearby creature and attack them with a bite, leeching 15% of damage done as health. If the creature is killed, you temporarily gain additional max HP. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Yorhavich.

spells.name: Heartstop
spells.description: Cast to inflict yourself with Heartstop, an effect that makes you temporarily invulnerable. However, once it wears off, you take 50% of all damage accumulated while under its effects.

spells.name: Raise Dead
spells.description: Cast to summon undead minions from the earth beneath you. The higher the power, the better equipment they will have.

spells.name: Ray of Siphoning
spells.description: Hold to cast a ray of necrotic energy that siphons health from creatures it hits, damaging them and healing you for 100% of damage done.

spells.name: Wither Skull
spells.description: Launch a wither skull forward that explodes in a small radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

spells.name: Sacrifice
spells.description: Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.description: Cast to interrupt any targeted magical process, such as a casting creature or a magical projectile.

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.description: Hold to spew a cone of dragon breath forwards. Each time a creature is hit, there is a chance to create a pool of dragon breath at their feet.

spells.name: Evasion
spells.description: Cast to imbue yourself with ender energy. Upon being attacked while under its effects, you will immediately teleport within a short radius and avoid taking any damage. Only a finite amount of hits can be dodged before the effect immediately wears off.

spells.name: Magic Arrow
spells.description: Hold to charge a piercing arrow made of arcane energy. This arrow has no gravity and can travel through blocks.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Shoot a bolt of concentrated arcane magic. Also a trademark of every wizard.

spells.name: Starfall
spells.description: Target a single area and continuously rain down arcane comets from above for the duration of the spell

spells.name: Teleport
spells.description: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, leaving nothing but a cloud of ender energy behind.

spells.name: Summon Ender Chest
spells.description: Apparate your Ender Chest inventory upon casting.

spells.name: Recall
spells.description: Warps you back to your spawn location, or world spawn if there is none.

spells.name: Portal
spells.description: Creates two portals that allows players to travel back and forth between them.

spells.name: Echoing Strikes
spells.description: Non-magical attacks will create an echo, producing a spectral sword to slam down in an area, or a piercing magical arrow to shoot the same target. Echoes do a percent of the original attack's damage.

spells.name: Black Hole
spells.description: Around a targeted location, create a fissure into the void, manifesting a black hole that will suck in nearby creatures and slowly crush them to death

spells.name: Summon Swords
spells.description: Conjure a trio of spectral armaments to aid in battle: a brawling shortsword, a quick rapier, and a tanking claymore. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Hazentouvel.

spells.name: Shadow Slash
spells.description: Dash forward with a arcing slash of arcane energy, striking creatures in an area. Projectiles hit are deflected. Scales off held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

spells.name: Arcane Shackle
spells.description: Hurl a bundle of arcane chains. Upon hitting a creature, cause three chains to bind it to the ground, each applying a tethering force. On miss, three chains lash out to unique nearby creatures. Chains can be damaged or dispelled.

spells.name: Gravity Fissure
spells.description: Split from the air a miniature Black Hole that moves forward in a line, pulling nearby creatures into its gravity well, but dealing no damage.

spells.name: Chain Creeper
spells.description: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a ring of creeper heads that falls to the ground and explodes. Any creature killed by this blast will conjure another, smaller, ring of creeper heads. This can chain multiple times.

spells.name: Fang Strike
spells.description: Conjure a line of evoker fangs in front of you, in classic illager fashion.

spells.name: Fang Ward
spells.description: Conjure protective rings of evoker fangs around you, in classic illager fashion.

spells.name: Firecracker
spells.description: Instantaneously conjure a firework where you look that explodes in a small radius around it.

spells.name: Gust
spells.description: Conjure a strong gust of wind, knocking back creatures in a conical shape, causing damage if they impact a wall

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.description: Cast to briefly grant yourself true invisibility, which hides armor and held items, but immediately wears off upon dealing damage. Mobs also lose aggro.

spells.name: Lob Creeper
spells.description: Lob the head of a creeper forward that explodes in a medium radius around the impact. The higher the level, the faster the projectile.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: Conjure a stationary shield of arcane energy where you look that will block projectiles and prevent creatures from passing.

spells.name: Spectral Hammer
spells.description: Conjure a spectral hammer out from where you look that will mine all connected stone-type blocks in a cube where it hits, leaving only ores and rubble behind.

spells.name: Summon Horse
spells.description: Conjure a spectral steed that will follow you around and only let you ride. The horse's speed, health, and jump height scales with spell power.

spells.name: Summon Vex
spells.description: Cast to conjure vexes that will follow, protect, and fight for you.

spells.name: Slow
spells.description: Apply the Slowed effect to a targeted creature, decreasing its movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.

spells.name: Arrow Volley
spells.description: Around a targeted creature or block, summon a rolling wave of magical arrows from the sky.

spells.name: Wololo
spells.description: Wololo!

spells.name: Throw
spells.description: Cast to throw your held item, dealing a base damage plus damage normally inflicted by the item.

spells.name: Fang Swirl
spells.description: Target a creature or block to conjure a spiraling zone of evoker fangs in a radius.

spells.name: Scapegoat
spells.description: Conjure a magical decoy in the form of a goat, which takes aggro from nearby hostile mobs and runs off into the distance, taunting them for a duration.

spells.name: Blaze Storm
spells.description: Hold to unleash a barrage of blaze fireballs, shooting rapidly but wildly in front of you and igniting any creatures or blocks hit.

spells.name: Burning Dash
spells.description: Quickly launch yourself forward in a haze of fire, searing creatures you pass through while in a blaze.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: Manifest and throw a ball of fire, exploding and dealing massive damage on impact.

spells.name: Firebolt
spells.description: Shoot a small projectile of fire, igniting whatever it hits.

spells.name: Fire Breath
spells.description: Hold to spew a cone of fire outwards, igniting creatures and blocks in its path.

spells.name: Magma Bomb
spells.description: Launch a bomb made from magma, exploding on impact and leaving a field of fire where it lands

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.description: Recast to place anchor points, which erupts into a wall of fire when the cast finishes, or when the maximum length is reached. This wall blocks projectiles and ignites creatures that pass through it.

spells.name: Heat Surge
spells.description: Emanate a surge of fiery magic, igniting and rending creatures in a radius around you. Rended creatures have reduced armor.

spells.name: Flaming Strike
spells.description: Unleash a sweeping melee attack in the form of a wreath of flames. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

spells.name: Scorch
spells.description: In a targeted area, erupt a scorch of fiery magic, damaging creatures in the zone and leaving a field of fire.

spells.name: Flaming Barrage
spells.description: Repeatedly cast to shoot individual small fireballs, which home towards your cursor, or the creature your cursor is targeting.

spells.name: Fire Arrow
spells.description: Aim an arrow made of fiery magic that will deal direct damage on impact and explode for half damage in a small radius around it. It flies straight for a duration before gravity affects it.

spells.name: Raise Hell
spells.description: Slam down your weapon to wreath a fiery shockwave in a large radius around you. Damage scales based on the held weapon.

spells.name: Angel Wings
spells.description: Cast to gain wings made of holy energy, acting as an elytra, for a brief period of time.

spells.name: Blessing of Life
spells.description: Cast to target any creature, showing a glowing outline. Completing the cast will heal this creature.

spells.name: Fortify
spells.description: Upon casting, fortify every friendly creature within a radius around you, giving them temporary HP.

spells.name: Greater Heal
spells.description: A more powerful but much slower version of heal, this spell will completely heal yourself upon being casted.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.description: Fire a slow bolt of holy energy. Creatures hit will gain the Guided effect, homing nearby projectiles in towards them

spells.name: Healing Circle
spells.description: Around a targeted creature or block, place a stationary circle of holy magic that heals allies within

spells.name: Heal
spells.description: Cast to infuse yourself with holy energy and immediately regain health.

spells.name: Sunbeam
spells.description: Funnel the power of the heavens into a beam of holy energy from above, smiting targets in an area.

spells.name: Wisp
spells.description: Conjure a projectile of holy energy that will float towards nearby targets and deal damage upon impact.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.description: With a fervor of holy energy, swing forth your weapon, doing a melee area attack. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.

spells.name: Haste
spells.description: To a targeted creature, or yourself if no creature is targeted, apply the Hastened effect, increasing movement speed, attack speed, mining speed, and cast time reduction for a duration.

spells.name: Cleanse
spells.description: Pray to a divine magic to cleanse yourself and nearby allies of harmful status effects.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.description: Hold to cast out a cone of cold energy, freezing creatures in its path.

spells.name: Frost Step
spells.description: Teleport to where you are looking, leaving behind a shadow of ice. This shadow will take nearby aggro, and shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

spells.name: Ice Block
spells.description: Conjure a giant chunk of ice above a targeted creature or block. After a short delay, it will fall down and explode for area frost damage, doing additional damage to any creatures hit on the way down.

spells.name: Icicle
spells.description: Fire a piercing bolt of cold energy in the form of an icicle, freezing those it touches.

spells.name: Summon Polar Bear
spells.description: Cast to summon a polar bear who will follow, protect, and fight for you, as well as providing a mount.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.description: Fire a beam of cold energy, dealing low damage but immediately applying freeze to the creature hit.

spells.name: Frostwave
spells.description: Cascade a wave of frost magic in a radius around you, afflicting creatures with chilled. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

spells.name: Ice Spikes
spells.description: Unleash a cascading line of ice magic, creating ice crystals that emerge from the ground. The final spike does full damage, and will emerge early if a creature within range is targeted.

spells.name: Ice Tomb
spells.description: Encase yourself in a protective tomb of ice, providing healing while within, absorbing one hit or counterspell before breaking. Dismount to leave the tomb.

spells.name: Snowball
spells.description: Conjure a giant snowball and throw it forward, bursting into a frosty field and Chilling creatures in a surrounding radius on impact. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.

spells.name: Frostbite
spells.description: Imbue yourself with a magical Frostbiting power, making any fully-frozen creature you kill turn into an Ice Shadow. Ice Shadows shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.

spells.name: Blizzard
spells.description: Channel a slow-moving, swirling blizzard at a targeted location, causing freezing wind and snow to pull creatures into the center of the vortex.

spells.name: Ascension
spells.description: Cast to strike lightning at your feet and ascend quickly into the air, and gain reduced gravity for a short duration. The lightning bolt deals damage and knocks back creatures struck.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: Start a chain of lightning from a targeted creature, causing waves of zapping magic to cascade to nearby creatures

spells.name: Charge
spells.description: Imbue yourself with the power of lightning, increasing your speed and combat abilities.

spells.name: Electrocute
spells.description: Hold to manifest a cone of electrical energy, damaging creatures in its path.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.description: Down from the heavens, summon a bolt of lightning.

spells.name: Lightning Lance
spells.description: Hold to charge a spear made of lightning. Release to throw it like a javelin, dealing high damage to the creature it hits.

spells.name: Shockwave
spells.description: Coalesce a surge of electrical power, and unleash it in a devastating shockwave, blasting exposed creatures.

spells.name: Thunderstorm
spells.description: Cast to conjure a thunderstorm centered around yourself, which strikes nearby creatures within sight with a small bolt of lightning every 2 seconds for the spell's duration.

spells.name: Ball Lightning
spells.description: Conjure an orb of lightning that slowly moves forward, damaging creatures it phases through and bouncing off blocks.

spells.name: Volt Strike
spells.description: Leap forward in a spinning voltaic attack, striking the first creature or surface you hit, and dealing a residual blast in a small area around around the impact.

spells.name: Acid Spit
spells.description: Spit an orb of acid, splashing in a radius upon impact and rending creatures hit, melting away and reducing their armor

spells.name: Blight
spells.description: Target a creature to blight them, reducing their incoming healing and outgoing damage

spells.name: Poison Arrow
spells.description: Charge a powerful arrow, imbued with poison magic, that will release a poisonous cloud upon impact

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.description: Spew forth a cone of poison, damaging and poisoning creatures in its reach

spells.name: Poison Splash
spells.description: Around a targeted creature or block, conjure a wave of poisonous magic that splashes down, damaging creatures hit and leaving behind a poisonous cloud

spells.name: Root
spells.description: Around a targeted creature, sprout magical roots than entangle them and completely prevent non-magical movement

spells.name: Aspect of the Spider
spells.description: Instill yourself with poisonous magic, dealing additional melee, ranged, or spell damage creatures that are poisoned

spells.name: Firefly Swarm
spells.description: Emanate a swarm of violent fireflies, following a targeted creature and dealing aoe damage. If the initial target dies, the last harmed creature will be targeted.

spells.name: Oakskin
spells.description: The great power of oak infuses itself into your skin, granting damage reduction of any incoming damage for a duration.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.description: Conjure an earthquake around a targeted creature or location, causing tremors to ripple through the ground, damaging and slowing creatures in the area.

spells.name: Stomp
spells.description: With a magic force, stomp the ground in front of you and send a short tremor forward through the ground, damaging creatures in its path.

spells.name: Gluttony
spells.description: Turn your stomach into an arcane furnace, turning eaten food into mana for a duration.

spells.name: Touch Dig
spells.description: Use magic to break a block. Held items affect drops.

spells.name: Abyssal Shroud
spells.description: Cloak yourself with the shadows of the abyss, granting the ability to evade any attack for a short duration of time.

spells.name: Sculk Tentacles
spells.description: From where you look, erupt a mass of sculk energy in the form of wailing tentacles, damaging and blinding creatures caught in the chaos.

spells.name: Sonic Boom
spells.description: Blast forth a sonic boom of immense power, passing through solid material and harming all creatures in its path.

spells.name: Planar Sight
spells.description: Shift your vision in between planes, gaining the ability to see creatures through solid material.

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.description: Reach out with a spectral force and grip a creature, forcing them towards your gaze. Creatures are susceptible to kinetic damage.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: Fire rays of pure, devastating energy.

spells.name: Pocket Dimension
spells.description: Cast to transport yourself into a personal pocket dimension only you can access, giving a small free range area.

spells.name: Summon Billy
spells.description: Raises Billy, a skeleton with a longsword, to fight for you. The rarer the spell, the better its weapon.

spells.name: Summon Wilson
spells.description: Raises Wilson, a skeleton with a spear, to fight for you. The rarer the spell, the better its weapon.

spells.name: Summon Ruffles
spells.description: Raises Ruffles, a skeleton archer, to fight for you. The rarer the spell, the better its weapon.

spells.name: Summon Rogier
spells.description: Raises Rogier, a skeleton with a rapier, to fight for you. The rarer the spell, the better its weapon.

spells.name: Summon Snickers
spells.description: Raises Snickers, a koboleton with a cutlass, to fight for you. The rarer the spell, the better its weapon.

spells.name: Summon Roobert
spells.description: Raises Roobert, a swift stray with a twinblade, to fight for you. The rarer the spell, the better its weapon.

spells.name: Summon Wasabi
spells.description: Raises Wasabi, a quick wither skeleton with a katana, to fight for you. The rarer the spell, the better its weapon.

spells.name: Summon Roowl
spells.description: Raises Roowl, a wither skeleton with a scythe that heals from its hits, to fight for you. The rarer the spell, the better its weapon.

spells.name: Soul Link
spells.description: A green wave spreads from you and links every ally it reaches. While linked, when one of them heals, the others heal a share of it. Summons heal twice that share.

spells.name: Spawn Breadly
spells.description: Raises Breadly, a sand snapper, to fight for you. The rarer the spell, the harder it bites.

spells.name: Summon Woofwoof
spells.description: Raises Woofwoof, a dread beast, to fight for you.

spells.name: Summon Wormatiatalamusanie
spells.description: Raises Wormatiatalamusanie, a koboleton with the Longsword of the Plague, to fight for you.

spells.name: Unweave
spells.description: Unravels the wards of every enemy around the spot you look at: their magic resistance drops for a few seconds, against every attacker.

spells.name: Reckoning
spells.description: A white bolt marks its target. For 6 seconds the mark stores part of all damage the target takes; when it fades, a share of the store strikes back as one spell hit.

spells.name: Ascension Field
spells.description: Raises a lifting column on the spot you look at. Everything inside rises slowly up to the ceiling and floats there. Cast again to close it; the cooldown starts when the field ends. Allies inside drift down safely.

spells.name: Bastion of the Bound
spells.description: All of your summons, wherever they are, take less damage for a while. The reduction comes last, after armor and resistances, and never passes 90%.

spells.name: Stormcaller
spells.description: For a while, every spear you throw that strikes a foe calls a lightning bolt down on it. Tridents, thrown spears and Lightning Lance all count. The bolt spares you and your allies and lights no fires.

spells.name: Voltaic Tether
spells.description: Binds you to the last spear you threw with a crackling line of lightning. The line follows you and burns every enemy it touches, until you stray too far, the spear is taken or time runs out.

spells.name: Thunder Recall
spells.description: You become lightning and race to the last spear you threw, straight through walls and creatures, shocking every foe along the way, then catch the spear back. You land safely beside it.

spells.name: Tesla Coil
spells.description: Plants a slender coil that shoots the nearest foe it can see. Coils standing close together are joined by crackling lines that burn anything crossing them. Plant a few to build a fence of lightning.

spells.name: Raiju
spells.description: Calls a wolf of living lightning to fight beside you. It strikes as a current, tearing through its prey and leaping on to other foes nearby before taking shape again behind the last.

spells.name: Railgun
spells.description: Fires a magnetic beam that pierces every foe in a line and hurls them back. Only a wall can stop it.

spells.name: Galvanize
spells.description: Charges the ally you look at, or yourself. Each weapon or arrow hit spends a charge to shock the foe, and while charges are plentiful the shock leaps to a second foe. Spent charges slowly return.

spells.name: Null Zone
spells.description: Seals the ground you look at. While it stands, nothing inside that is not your friend can teleport: no pearls, no blinks, no ender tricks.

spells.name: Flame Aura
spells.description: Wreathes you in fire. Every half second, foes close around you burn for fire damage.

spells.name: Radiant Aura
spells.description: Wreathes you in holy light. Every half second, foes close around you are seared; the undead suffer more.

spells.name: Verdant Aura
spells.description: Wreathes you in living green. Every second, you and the friends around you heal.

spells.name: Sporecap
spells.description: Grows a glowing mushroom where you look. Each second it bursts with spores that hurt every foe within reach.

spells.name: Growth Cube
spells.description: Sets a small cube of living light over the ground. Every few seconds it ripens nearby crops by one stage.

spells.name: Death Field
spells.description: Spreads a field of death on the ground that hurts every foe in it. Each creature that dies inside makes it stronger. Cast again to end it early.

spells.name: Heat Mirage
spells.description: Leaves a burning afterimage where you stand. Cast again while it lasts to return to it as it bursts into flame.

spells.name: Kindling Link
spells.description: Chains the foes in front of you with fire. Part of the damage any of them takes burns the others too.

spells.name: Searing Mark
spells.description: Brands a foe with a burning sigil. It takes more from every kind of fire, and its flames burn longer.

spells.name: Symbiosis
spells.description: Binds you to a friend with a living vine. You take part of the damage meant for them, and both of you slowly heal.

spells.name: Rime Lash
spells.description: Cracks a whip of frost across the half circle in front of you. Every foe it catches takes ice damage and gathers Rime.

spells.name: Permafrost Sigil
spells.description: Raises a floating ice crystal. It sends out icy waves that chill every foe around it; foes already deep in Rime are hurt by them.

spells.name: Cold Snap
spells.description: Shatters the Rime on every foe near you. Each stack bursts for ice damage.

spells.name: Glacial Cleave
spells.description: Bring your weapon down in a crescent of frost. Hits harder with a stronger weapon, and finds weak spots on foes deep in Rime.

spells.name: Hailstorm
spells.description: Hail circles your head and hurls itself at foes that come close, chilling them with Rime.

spells.name: Crimson Frenzy
spells.description: Cast to start, cast again to stop. Your blood burns for speed: you move, strike and cast faster, but bleed every second and heal far less.

spells.name: Sanguine Form
spells.description: Become living blood for a moment: nothing hurts you, you fly and slip through creatures, and the first foe you pass through feeds you.

spells.name: Aegis of Light
spells.description: Hold to raise a pane of light in front of you. Hostile projectiles break or bounce off it, and blows struck through it at you or your friends land softer.

spells.name: Dawn Bell
spells.description: Hangs a golden bell where you look. Its peal heals your friends and reveals foes; the undead are seared and held in place.

spells.name: Guardian Angel
spells.description: Wards the friends in a small circle where you look, or yourself. A warded one who would fall is saved once and slowly mended.

spells.description: Hurls a spear of light that pins the first foe it strikes, then stands in the ground shining and searing the undead nearby.

spells.name: Blood Well
spells.description: Pay with your own blood to raise a well where you stand. While foes in its circle are wounded, it feeds you and your friends there, mending them and dulling the blows they take.

spells.name: Death Mark
spells.description: Paint a mark of death over the foe you look at. Your summons turn on it and strike it harder while the mark lasts.

spells.name: Danse Macabre
spells.description: Your summons nearby dance to death's tune: they strike and move faster, but the dance slowly wears at them, never to their end.

spells.name: Soul Reel
spells.description: Hurl a soul you steer with your gaze. It tears through foes on the way out, then reels back to you and mends the summons it passes, more for every foe it struck.

spells.name: Spectral Echo
spells.description: Call up a ghostly echo of yourself, armed as you are. It fights at your side with your own strength, but strikes softer and breaks easier than you.

spells.name: Bloodletting
spells.description: Open a vein and let your blood turn to mana. Costs part of your health, never your life, and restores a share of your mana at once.

spells.name: Blood Rite
spells.description: Paint a blood sigil on the ground. After a short while it erupts, striking hard and slowing every foe still inside it.

spells.name: Tides of Blood
spells.description: Hold to gather your own blood around you, paying a little health for each wave gathered. Let go and it bursts outward, farther and harder the more you gathered.

spells.description: Throw a fan of blood daggers. Each one that strikes stays in the foe, slowing it and making it take more from blood magic.
